name: Grade - Default (seed v1)
description: An item rarity level (1-10 stars): its name, how often lootboxes pick it, and how far enchantment books may raise items of this grade. Item blueprints pick a grade.

steps.description: Name the grade and set its stars, lootbox odds and enchantment cap. Changes reach the game server within about 10 minutes, also for items that already exist.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players wherever the grade is named, e.g. in enchantment-book messages ("Its grade is Common"). Renaming is safe: nothing in code depends on the name.

fields.label: Stars
fields.description: The grade's rank, 1 (Common) to 10. Items carry their grade as this number and show it as a star line in their lore, so give every grade a different number. Lootboxes use grades 1-5 only.

fields.label: Drop chance (%)
fields.description: Relative weight, 0-100, with which lootboxes pick this grade for a box and for the item inside (a lootbox type can override it). Higher means more common; decimals like 0.05 are allowed. Empty counts as 0: never picked.

fields.label: Enchantment cap divisor
fields.description: An enchantment book can raise an item of this grade only up to the enchantment's max level divided by this number, rounded down (Sharpness V on divisor 2: up to II). At least 1; 1 allows the full max level. Leave empty for no cap at all (grades 6-10). Custom enchantments are not capped.
